title: navigating by moonlight: pisces season
content:
this is a calendar for my community, Labyrinth Library.

I made this calendar as a visual map of what we’re working with inside Labyrinth, this Pisces season. and while, being a scorpio stellium, I really don’t need a reason to immerse myself in the lunar, intuitive waters of the unconscious realms, this season has given me a clear container for deliberately thinking about the practice and process of working with Pisces energy — as something we can cultivate, much like we can go to the gym to work on our ab muscles.

I am interested in turning “problems” into power. I am interested in elevating the tender softness that our mainstream culture minimizes, and diminishes. I am interested in the how. I am obsessed with training in the skills of our unseen faculties, in a place and paradigm far beyond what our productivity driven, materialist cultural programming can see, or understand. we know that these realms exist, and it is necessary for our psychic (thus material) survival.


the questions of Pisces:

how do we connect to the unconscious realms, in a way that feels safe?
how do we practice intuitive knowing — and trusting in that sensed knowing?
how do we be with the not-yet, imaginal worlds, without feeling overwhelmed?
how do we make our sensitivity and poreousness a gift, rather than a curse?
how do we move through our relationships with conscious devotion?

artifacts

to grapple with these questions, I’ve created 4 teaching artifacts for Pisces season. you can explore 3 of them as excerpted previews, and Semi-Permeable Membrane as a public offering, in this Notion artifacts library.

Infinity Lake — is about total immersion in the creative psyche, surrendering yourself to lunar waters, exploring what you discover in the recesses of your imagination, and diving to the bottom to look for secret treasures.

Crystal Orb — is about being with your foggy, inner vision. this means finding comfort in the murky spaces of the not-yet. the crystal orb isn’t about seeking clarity, but sensing into the emergence of possibility. bearing witness to the cloudiness, without trying to resolve it. intuition is something you sense, and choose to trust in — with no guarantees.

Semi-Permeable Membrane — is about tending to the psychic barrier between self and world, or between raw substance and creative form. it is about filtration, insulation, and metabolizing life experiences by giving it shape, and offering it ways of release.

The Cord That Binds Us — is about practicing devotion as something we choose consciously, rather than as a burden created by a fluid state of self.

guiding trail-markers

because the Labyrinth is a metaphor for a spiraling, nonlinear path, I’ve chosen weekly guiding themes that I’m calling “trail-markers” — to describe the experience of stumbling upon a sign in the middle of the wild — something to help orient you in where you are.

a trail-marker word describes a specific creative phase; a practice of noticing and naming — so that when you encounter it again, you’ll be able to name where you are.

for Pisces season, the trail-marker words are:

THRESHOLDS: the boundary between places or states of being; a passageway between here & there, the liminal moment in between. (personally, I’m in a big threshold year, in my Hanged Man season.)

SENSING: sensing is about being with felt, intuitive knowing — something that defies clean, logical explanation, but lives as a felt experience that we learn to notice, and develop ongoing responses to.

SHAPING: giving form to raw creative substance. transforming the immaterial, sensed creative urges and impulses into emergent shapes or creative containers. the work of shaping always feels like a ongoing conversation with creative energy.

DEVOTION: choosing devotion as a practice of active tending and surrender. devotion doesn’t mean being off center, or always orbiting around the other — but a practice of spiritual love that allows, accepts, and expands. the practice is about devotion and freedom — to self, creative work, or other.

walking the foggy, moon-lit path

as for my own experience of Pisces this year — I’ve felt keenly that this is a season in which I’ve stirred up complex, foggy, murky emotional and creative energy with no clear resolution attached to it. I’m understanding that resolution is not what I need right now.

part of the work has been allowing immersion — into the infinity lake, into the feeling of walking a foggy path, being in cloudwater (to use words from a recent discussion session in Labyrinth!). the ongoing questioning and grappling with the messiness of process, with heavy, layered emotions, with a life that is sensed as hovering shadows in the distance, with a process of metabolism that feels so slow it seems like nothing visible is happening — to the outside world — that all of this is… okay.

it is okay to be here, navigating by moonlight. you are safe here. and there are deep gifts here, waiting for you.
